summary: Focused regression on 3 new features: (1) LinkedIn/portfolio inputs in Dados pessoais rendered in cv-preview contact line with https://www. stripped; (2) Resume rascunho on another phone via KP-XXXXXX code + 4-digit PIN (create/get/revoke, resume-with-wrong-pin shows generic 401, resume-with-correct-pin navigates back to same draft, revoked code is unusable); (3) WhatsApp share button on APPROVED order page uses wa.me/?text=... with text-only (no phone, no http link). Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases (test_resume_code.py) passed. Frontend: full Playwright flow passed. Admin payment settings/published flag NOT touched.
critical_code_review_comments: Resume code endpoints (server.py:219-280) implement correct generic 401 for wrong code+wrong pin, 400 for invalid pin format, 410 for expired, 429 on 5th wrong attempt with 15-min lockout. attempts counter reset to 0 at lockout and after successful resume. Good defensive design.
resume_codes TTL index on expires_at (server.py:644) will auto-purge expired codes.
DELETE /api/drafts/{token} also deletes associated resume_codes (server.py:205) — correct cascade.
CVPreview.shortUrl strips https?://(www\.)? and trailing slash; applied only to linkedin/portfolio (not phone/email). Correct per spec.
OrderStatus.jsx WA_TEXT (line 8) is text-only cordial Portuguese message; href uses wa.me/?text=encodeURIComponent(WA_TEXT) — no phone number embedded in URL and no http link in text body. Spec met.

ResumeCodeDialog correctly fetches existing code on mount (GET), shows create vs existing views, and copy button writes to clipboard. One minor UX note: when PIN input is >4 chars, button is disabled (good).
